name: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc.
business_overview: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc., a multi-platform media company, owns and operates radio stations in the United States. It operates in two segments, Audio and Digital. The company offers local and national advertisers integrated marketing solutions across audio, digital, and event platforms. Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. was founded in 1961 and is based in Naples, Florida.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Multi-platform media company operating radio stations, generating revenue from advertising sales.

The firm has carved a niche in Public Private Partnerships (PPP) and Private Finance Initiative (PFI) infrastructure assets, concentrating on availability-based projects. This includes investments in essential facilities such as schools, hospitals, and transportation infrastructure across Europe, North America, Australia, and New Zealand.
